items.message: Error message from `gh pr ready` reflects the PR number from the caller-supplied `ChangeRequest`, but also reflects the raw `err` string from the subprocess, which could contain attacker-influenced content if the GitHub API or gh CLI echoes back a PR title or body. The number itself originates from a prior `open_change` call so is not externally injectable here, but `err.strip()` is passed verbatim into a `RuntimeError` that may be logged or surfaced upstream. The option-confusion guard (`if ref.startswith("-")`) is added only in `_resolve_base_ref` (the `GitLocal` path). The `GitHubScm.open_change` also accepts a `base` parameter and appends it to the `gh pr create` argument list (`args += ["--base", base]` on line 84).
